snippet.title: Winter Heat - DEMO AND KICKSTARTER LIVE!
snippet.description:
Javi lives in Santiago, and Shio lives in Kyoto. They're best friends over the internet, until one fateful December brings them even closer together than ever before. A single-path visual novel about long-distance love.

Support the Kickstarter here and get some awesome rewards! https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/thedude3445/winter-heat-yuri-visual-novel

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3429850/Winter_Heat
Play the demo on browser: https://yuri-kissaten.itch.io/winter-heat
(Demo is available to download on both Steam and Itch.io!)

[Music used in this video]
a really cute girl in a really fancy coffee shop
https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/844745
